External hosted players (no redistributed code or media)

Twitch clip embeds: https://clips.twitch.tv/embed
Documentation: https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/embed/video-and-clips/
Terms: https://www.twitch.tv/p/en/legal/terms-of-service/

MustachedManiac hosted Twitch Clip Player:
https://mustachedmaniac.com/widgets/Twitch_Clip_Player

These independent remote services retain their respective ownership and terms.
Only iframe URLs are constructed by this package. No remote player implementation,
clip media, thumbnails, personal channel identifiers or credentials are bundled.
The project's MIT licence covers first-party integration code only. No licence to
redistribute third-party media or player code is asserted. Availability, autoplay,
content restrictions and mute support remain subject to the selected provider.
